items.text: Welcoming host, got an explanation of everything and a whatsapp contact for any further queries.  The Apartment is located about 10-15 Minutes walk from the city center, which is quite convenient. It is very quiet and modern.  We would definetely book again.

I just really like the flat, it's simple but have a sense of design, you can get everything you need in the room, live in this flat you will feel happy and comfortable. The host Elisabetta is a nice and friendly person she told us the detailed route to the flat and also restaurants and place that worth to go, thanks for the information Elisabetta! The location also very ideally and centrally you can go to most scenery spot by walk. It is absolutely the right choice to live in Florence.

John and Hilde were incredibly welcoming and friendly during our stay. They gave us a quick guide on things to do in Oslo and made sure we had everything we needed to enjoy our short time in Oslo. Moreover, they extended their help in case we had flight delays, etc which I thought was extremely kind. Their place is clean, easy to find, and just as shown in the pictures! A huge plus, their bathroom is super clean and I'm a huge fan of clean bathrooms. We took all their recommendations and are glad we did. Highly recomend all to stay here!

I stayed at Cindy’s property while in town for a dog show at the Isanti County Fairgrounds. It was the perfect place, easy drive away from traffic, peaceful, clean, safe, spacious—all the things I look for when traveling alone with my dog.  Great communication ahead of time. She let me know there were intact male dogs on the property as this is a working horse farm. I have an intact female that happened to be coming in season while traveling so I appreciated knowing this. The boys were NO problem. Friendly dogs, well trained and respectful of space, I was easily able to verbally keep them at a safe distance when walking my dog around to potty or to and from the car. They were a delight to watch work with the horses, and happily accept affection when invited.  This is a great, spacious place to stay, plenty of room to spread out. It is a walkout basement space, so do be aware of that. There are stairs and a patio you can use to get close to the entrance, but a short distance is just grass. No problem for me but something to be aware of if you’re needing to wheel heavy luggage. It’s a fantastic value especially for the price! Definitely recommend!

This airbnb is one of the best ones we’ve stayed in. It looks just like the pictures. Finding the place wasn’t difficult and Check in was as easy as it can be. The place is close to grocery stores and food places. The house was clean and the outdoor entertainment areas are so nice. Even though you’re in a neighborhood it feels like you’re in your own little oasis.  The salt water pool was clean and quite nice. The house had everything we needed from cooking utensils to toiletries. Even taking a shower was fun because of the shower speaker. The hosts were super quick to respond, accommodating and had good suggestions for what’s around the area. We had a great time and would definitely come back and stay here.
Simone was sooo helpful. Always responded to any questions we had. We really enjoyed our stay and the apartment was spotless, comfortable and well maintained. Highly recommend his place.

Maxime's place is great. I stayed there for 5 nights and felt very comfortable and safe. The bed is very comfortable! I haven't slept that well for a while :) Maxime is a great host, very clear and direct with the requirements and rules making living there and respecting the space happen. This is particularly key as you might share the restroom and kitchen with another Airbnb guest. Maxime was also very quick and responsive. All information was clearly communicated ahead of time. The neighborhood is very convenient - very close to 125th train stop if you need to go down to Manhatten for work. Also close to a lot of great restaurants in Harlem! Perfect place to explore this part of town.

Biagio's place overall was really great and we would recommend to anyone looking for a unique, romantic place to stay in Ragusa! Biagio was very quick to reply always and was super nice and informative in person. Our only criticism is we were made a little uncomfortable with the unexpected extra charges, such as the spa being extra and the mini fridge in the room having a price list on the top if we wanted to eat/drink anything that was in there. Apart from that, my husband and I loved the place and enjoyed meeting Biagio!

Very interesting property! David was excellent and welcoming. He was flexible with everything as there was a movie being filmed near by and he wanted us to get the best stay possible. Expect something different here and very quiet peaceful rest in the quiet of topanga hills

Gonçalo ist ein super Gastgeber. Er hat geduldig auf uns gewartet und uns dann alles super erklärt,gezeigt und Tipps gegeben.  Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und bietet alles was man für eine Städtereise in Lissabon braucht. Sie liegt sehr zentral. So sind Bus,Tram,Zug,Schiff und Metro alles zu Fuss erreichbar. Zum Teil sind die Nachbarn etwas laut, für diesen Fall hat Gonçalo aber Oropax in der Wohnung.  Ausserdem ist es im Winter etwas kalt in der Wohnung, obwohl Gonçalo extra 2 Heizofen bereit gestellt hat, würde ich warme Kleidung und evt. Hausschuhe empfehlen.  Rund herum total zufrieden und bestimmt erste Wahl für den nächsten Lissabon Aufenthalt:)

Wonderful stay in Copenhagen at Peter's place. The apartment is SO well placed, literally in front of the most iconic place in the city : Nyhavn (with all the colorful houses). We visited everything by foot, it's not that far (from 10 to 45 minutes), and there is plenty of restaurants and grocery stores nearby. The house on itself is great, has everything you need and a wonderful swimming-pool-like kitchen. Peter was really nice and welcomed us with great tips about the city, if you go to Copenhagen, you definitely have to stay at his place !

Monsour is the man. He’s beyond polite and accommodating. He makes you feel like your at home from the moment you walk in, and makes himself available to your needs at any time. I highly recommend staying with him to anyone.
Spacious bedrooms and a well equipped kitchen. I will definitely be recommending this property in future to larger groups of people who want to stay in the area.

O apartamento é excelente. Com certeza tentarei ficar nele novamente em uma futura visita ao Rio. A localização é muito boa, sendo que o uber chega rápido, é próximo à estação de metrô, tem padaria e mercado perto, sushi em frente, bares e outros restaurantes no entorno, fica a 3 minutos da areia de Copacabana e 15 de Ipanema a pé. Fica no último andar do prédio, então acaba sendo bem silencioso. Recomendo!

First class accommodation we stayed here at the end of our holiday in South Africa. The property is in a really nice area with lots of places to see and visit close by, we selected it primarily because it was enroute to the airport for us but we were very surprised to see how good it really was and we would have definitely booked to stay here longer if we could have.
Very well decorated place in a good location. Host responds very quickly. I would book this place again.

Akin is in an incredible host . Due to a series of flight delays and bag issues, I was over 3 hours late arriving in Munich. Akin came to the airport to get me to spare me the Taxi cost! I offered to pay him, but he insisted it wasn't necessary.    His flat is in a very convenient location, incredibly clean, and cosy for 1-2 people doing work in the city. I can't recommend him highly enough!

Gloria and Oliver were most helpful, friendly and welcoming hosts. The apartment was beautifully decorated- clean, bright, deceptively spacious and the terrace ,full of beautiful plants, was perfect. We enjoyed breakfast outside every day. Every attention was made to detail and we can thoroughly recommend staying in this perfectly situated and delightful haven. We had a wonderful time. Valencia was more than we could have hoped for- very friendly, weather perfect and a vibrant city. Surrounded by all amenities we were in the best spot. A magical week! Thank you!
Lovely apartment, great location right by the Basilica, hosts were very accomodating letting us checkout late and leave bags in the apartment

Fantastic flat in an excellent location. We arrived in the evening and did not have to worry about shopping for milk or food as the fruit basket, fridge and food cupboard were full of things to eat and drink - most unexpected. Claudia was waiting to greet us in her charming and delightful way. Can't wait to go back.

WORTH EVERY PENNY !!!  This rental saved our vacay!  We originally had another unit, in same complex from another host and it was terrible!  We luckily happened upon this listing and sue to an emergency cancellation we were able to move to this wonderful 2bd, 2ba.  As soon as you walk in, it feels comfortable and inviting.  Great decor.  Kitchen stocked well with essentials.  Even snacks and coffee was there (a much appreciated extra). Until was clean, beds were comfy.  It was a great stay!  The proximity to the pool was convenient and so easy to hop in an Uber and get to the strip. The hosts were very responsive.   I would recommend this unit to everyone!   Our vacation day #1 started out as a mini nightmare and THIS completely saved the whole trip!

This cabin stay has been the highlight of my year. Absolutely gorgeous and peaceful. Ben was proactive throughout our stay and kind enough to be flexible on our check out time.  Will definitely be returning again. Regards,  Reyon Lobo
nice appartament in the very nice area.  View is 10/10, near beaches is 10/10. Great place to stay for vacation 👌
Bob and Amy are great. The place is just as advertised, easy access to food, activities .... Super duper clean, quiet and private!

Great host, superb location next to federation square/flinders station/cafes etc.  Alice was there to meet us the apartment was immaculate and they had information about our stay in Melbourne.  Highly recommend. Thx

Nous avons très apprécié notre séjour chez Maxine. L’appartement est grand et très propre. L'appartement est très bien situé pour visiter Lisbonne et sa région. On peut garer la voiture dans la rue. C'est un quartier très calme et à proximité de la plage. Maxine nous a très bien reçu. Elle est très gentille et accueillante. Elle nous a donné de bonnes adresses de restaurants et on a pu partager avec elle nos expériences de visites. De plus, elle nous a fourni un lit parapluie, une chaise haute et des jouets pour notre bébé.  Cette attention a été très appréciée. Merci Maxine pour votre accueil et nous recommandons votre adresse.

La casa é come da descrizione, dotata davvero di tutto il necessario e anche di più, è luminosa e ce una bella terrazza. La nostra stanza era perfetta per due persone e anche il bagno comodo. L’unica menzione è che abbiamo trovato un po impolverate le mensole del letto e un cassetto non pulitissimo.  È in una zona credo gipsy, a tratti può sembrare una zona povera, poco curata, ma ha il suo fascino perché molto particolare e a noi è piaciuta, anche se la sera essendo aprile non c’era quasi nulla di locali aperti a parte i ristoranti. Molto vicino al mare e a metro/tram/bus che passano frequentemente e ti portano in poco tempo in centro. Paolo molto gentile e  disponibile

Rosa is exactly the contact you need when you need a true resource. She opens her home to you, helps you along your stay by offering suggestions and making you safe, and is extremely easy to work with. She’s a gem of a human being and I fully intend to revisit this property again in our next stay. She made this whole experience so wonderful!

Amy's place is a gem in Capitol Hill! It's within 2 mins walk to Metro (Potomac Ave Station) and Bus station. A very desirable location for visitors to reach all the attractions at DC. We also rented a car for half of the trip, parking is not as difficult as we anticipated. We were lucky enough to find parking alongside the streets outside Amy's place for the few nights even it's already quite late in the evening. Do pay attention to the rules stated and abide to it to avoid being ticketed. Love the spotless clean bath room,  very quiet AC and and a very functional laundry room.  The street is very residential and quiet.  And, yes, Amy is truly just an email away whenever I have any questions, thanks Amy! We enjoyed our stay very much!

The apartment is clean and great value for money! The flat is excellently positioned for sightseeing and shopping around the city streets ! Aim is very kind and helpful He will give you of very good advice! The apartment is a little bit small for four people but for 2 people it’s perfect!

We were very happy with this apt. Perfect location, immaculate condition, nicely furnished and very comfortable. Emi made us right at home with a warm welcome, offered us food and drink, restaurant recommendations and answered all of our questions promptly. She's a lovely hostess who seems to enjoy guests and truly shares her home.

Nice and cozy studio in a quiet side street. Around the corner there is a small kiosk and within 5 minutes walking distance you will find a supermarket and lots of restaurants, tavernas at the seaside. The old town of Parikia and the port where ferries arrive/depart can be reached within 7 minutes walking distance. Very good location of the house to which the studio belongs. If you have a rental car it can sometimes be difficult to park your car nearby as you need to look at the other side streets, but all in all it's not been an issue.  Jean-Philippe & Hervé were great hosts, very polite, nice recommendations on beaches, restaurants on the island and they both speak excellent english.

Amazing host, very understanding and kind hearted. House was very clean, I came around Christmas it was decorated, smelled good at all times, always had access to everything I needed. DEFINITELY recommended!

El apartamento de Tomaso es increbile. La ubicación perfecta, las vistas inmejorables. Además subir los tres pisos de escaleras hace que te sientas menos culpable al disfrutar de la gastronomía florentina.  Nos permitieron hacer el ckeck-in antes, Sibilla es un encanto de mujer. Lo recomiendo sin lugar a dudas.
Fiona was always there if I needed anything and responded very quickly. Made me feel comfortable and reassured me if I had any queries during my 10-day stay. Would definitely recommend!
This place is a gem, considering its location on top of this makes it even more so.  Treat yourself and book your holiday at Aleksandra’s place is a must.

To start with the positive things: this real estate is located in a beautiful area at a magnificent beach and has 3 pinetrees in the garden. The gardenshower we loved!  But we were not very happy about the circumstances of the house. The whole house is not well equipped what we expected for this price!  The bathrooms are in bad conditions, the towel holders are shabby and a lot of furnitures are from Ikea. Beach lies are old, sticky and not clean. All in all everything is pretty primitiv. We got 3 ventilators, so we could cool down a little bit by night when it was 27 degrees. On the online Fotos seem a lot of much bigger. The rooms are much more smaller then it seemed on the pictures. We were there with 5 adults which was okay...  we had 2 little children with us and that is important to say: the house is not safe! Mainly the fences at the stairs are dangerous because they again are cheap and not well fixed in the walls. Lucky we were enough adults to look after the children, otherwise the parents could not have had holidays.

The comfort and views are incomparable! The kitchen is a delight! Although the toilet was on a lower floor whilst the bedroom on the upper floor, it was never a problem. Additionally, although the walk to and from the train station was steep, it was quite walkable and hugely enjoyable. However, with travel bags it would be quite an effort coming up. We were picked up at the train station and delivered again so no problem. Beautiful views!!! Also, Abel was so kind to have his houseman drive us. A wonderful stay!! Quite a magical stay!! We took daily train rides to surrounding areas, and swam in the beautiful lake.

We had a lovely time at  the farmstay.  It is what you would expect with animals to feed and to with. Very peaceful place to break away from the city. Updated photos would have been beneficial for accuracy.

Nos sentimos como en casa ! La habitación es tal cual se muestra en las fotos, super limpia, ordenada y cómoda. El resto de las instalaciones también.  Ammar es un excelente anfitrión , muy atento , amable y flexible con los horarios. Tiene un perrito que se llama Roco que es muy amigable, simpático y educado. Respecto a la ubicación, mejor no podía ser.. tenes todo a pocos minutos a pie, no fue necesario tomar ningún bus ni metro.  Nos encanto la experiencia. Sin duda repetiremos !! Gracias !

Great apartment that is located about a 10 minute scooter ride down to the Santa Monica Pier.  This apartment comes with everything that you need and had nice personal touches (mini bar and cute, curated bookshelves).  It also has a parking spot, which was very convenient for a rental car.  The neighborhood overall was very quiet and we didn't hear the neighbors at all.  Lots of good local restaurants nearby, as well as a CVS and Target within walking distance.  Overall, we had a wonderful stay!

I had a great stay at Anna and Ian's apartment. It was really clean, felt very spacious and was in a great location for getting into Valletta and for exploring the rest of Malta. The apartment was a nice mix of historic and modern, and I really enjoyed using the enclosed balcony which was a great spot for enjoying breakfast in the morning sunshine. Also very relieved that it had air conditioning! Before I arrived, Anna provided helpful instructions on how to get there, as well as a huge list of restaurant and sightseeing recommendations which I really appreciated and helped me make the most of my time on the island. Anna was also quick at responding when I had an issue and offered to come and help sort it. I had a great time staying in the apartment, and would definitely recommend to other travellers!

Com certeza Massimo foi o melhor anfitrião que tivemos na Itália. Deu ótimas dicas sobre como andar em Veneza, lugares para visitar, onde comer... Tudo com muito humor e de um jeito muito especial. Foi ótimo conversar com um verdadeiro cidadão de Veneza, só isso já valeria a pena. Sobre a acomodação, o melhor que tivemos até agora no Airbnb. O lugar é ótimo, muito limpo, ar condicionado, cozinha realmente completa... Enfim, tudo perfeito. Acomodação e anfitrião Recomendadíssimos.

The appartment was centrally located and was extremely clean! The bed was comfy and carlos and victoria were quick to respond to any of my messages. I would def recommend staying here! Only thing i could think of that was missing was a bottle opener. But that was just a very small thing. Had a great stay thank you guys!

Julie's Studio was just what I was looking for in Sydney. It was very comfortable and the location could not have been more perfect. Julie was a great host, very helpful and friendly. I enjoyed my stay.

This place is in the heart of Brooklyn. Very convenient location about 20 minutes from Manhattan. The apartment is clean, organized very well, and close to the subways. Travis is a sweetheart and very helpful and responsive to all communications. I am renting this place again soon!

This property was perfect for our extended family gathering for a special birthday. We were a party of 8 with other family members staying nearby and dropping in over the weekend. The weather was not good but the ample and cosy warm spaces more than compensated and the games room downstairs was put to good use. Of course the spectacular views have and extra drama in wild conditions! We appreciated the friendly and prompt responses from Roger and Miranda, comfortable beds with electric blankets, the very well equipped kitchen and can also highly recommend nearby Illume Restaurant.

Kamila met me in front of the building at exactly the hour she said.She is a really nice person who gave me some tips about Porto, and she responded quickly to messages on airbnb when I have a question. The apartment itself is located not far from the good districts, and around 15min by walking from the center, there are two metro near (5min away) and buses too. The apartment is in the last floor of the building (stairs only), the inside is neither big or small, my bedroom was pretty big, they are two bathroom, one with a bathtub toilet sink and a chair, the other one is really small and has a toilet and sink so it's nice when the first bathroom is already occupied. There is a little balcony with a nice view. They are 4 bedrooms , and the apartment has a lot of noise issues (door and floor creaky, even if you try to close/open doors slowly or walk smoothly) so you heard a lot of noises the morning and the night from the others guest, or even from yourself, for example my bed did a lot of noises I couldn't move without it grind but it was still confortable to sleep in, the noises are the only issues I had during the 5 days I was there. I recommand the place, Kamila is a really kind

The host was very responsive and helpful. She worked with Airbnb as we extend our trip a day. I had made a mistake and both Airbnb and the host worked together and fixed it. The condo is very clean and pretty view. Everything was available.  It’s just too crowded for my husband and I but that’s  just our preference and next time we would get the ocean front condo.   I would only suggest extending the check out to 11am like many other condos. Thank you very much for working with us!!!

Bell appartameto in stile veneziano, dotato di tutto il necessario. Ubicato a pochi minuti a piedi da piazza San Marco,  in zona tranquilla.  Ottima location per passare una bella vacanza nella bellissima Venezia
